IRGC Public Relations Department said a US MQ-9 unmanned aerial vehicle was brought down over Ahvaz (Khuzestan) by the IRGC Aerospace Force's new advanced air defence system operating under Iran's integrated air defence network. No immediate comment from US officials.
Carried by Middle East Monitor, CGTN, ANI (timestamped 19 July 2026). UNCONFIRMED by approved sources.
